what: Neon sign flicker: hollow outline text (4px stroke) with a white core and a four-direction glow (15px offset, 50px blur, 50% color) is lit, then every 12 seconds it switches off and on for .12s twice between 19–25% and once at 54–56% — the glow is 20px at widths of 767px or less.

options.look: With wait, only an outline without glow is kept until the is-on class is added to the element — to switch it on mid-entrance (in the original, when the text fade is half done)
options.--fx-blur: Blur (via style), default 50px · --fx-blur-narrow 20px at widths of 767px or less

note: The original keyframes write 0% twice (no light, then light on), and the later one wins, so it runs lit from the start. Old values renamed like text-shadow1, 2 and 3 are lines the browser discards, so they were not carried over. The original’s hover breathing effect (neon2 1.5s) is left out because its button (#button2) is not on the page.

from.where: index.html Hero right panel .neon-text — M PLUS Rounded 1c 900 100px (80 at 1279 and below · 60 at 1023 and below · 50 at 767 and below), 4px #76ffeb stroke, blink 12s infinite (blink_sp on phones), is-animated once the letter fade is half done
